Delhi Police Rescue Kidnapped Teen Using UPI Transfer

Delhi Police rescued a 13-year-old who had been kidnapped within three hours by using a Rs 5,000 UPI transfer to track the abductor. The operation involved sending the money via UPI to locate the kidnapper.
